content: दण्डः, -ण्डम् [दण्ड्-अच्] .²1 A stick, staff, rod, mace, club, cudgel; पततु शिरस्यकाण्डयमदण्ड इवैष भुजः <ls>Māl. 5. 31</ls>; काष्ठदण्डः. .²2 The sceptre of a king, the rod as a symbol of authority and punishment; आत्तदण्डः <ls>Ś. 5. 8</ls>. .²3 The staff given to a twice-born man at the time of investiture with the sacred thread; cf <ls>Ms. 2. 45-48</ls>. .²4 The staff of a संन्यासिन् or ascetic. .²5 The trunk of an elephant. .²6 The stem or stalk as of a lotus, tree <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>U. 1. 31</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 14</ls>; the handle as of an umbrella; ब्रह्माण्डच्छत्रदण्डः <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Dk. 1</ls> (opening verse); राज्यं स्वहस्तधृतदण्डमिवातपत्रम् <ls>Ś. 5. 6</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 89</ls>; so कमलदण्ड <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 The oar of a boat. .²8 An arm or leg (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²9 The staff or pole of a banner, a tent <ab>&c.</ab> .²10 The beam of a plough. .²11 The cross-bar of a lute or a stringed instrument. .²12 The stick with which an instrument is played. .²13 A churning-stick. .²14 Fine; <ls>Ms. 8. 341</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 229</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 237</ls>. .²15 Chastisement, corporal punishment, punishment in general; यथापराधदण्डानाम् <ls>R. 1. 6</ls>; एवं राजापथ्यकारिषु तीक्ष्णदण्डो राजा <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; दण्डं दण्डपेषु पातयेत् <ls>Ms. 8. 126</ls>; कृतदण्ड स्वयं राज्ञा लेभे शूद्रः सतां गतिम् <ls>R. 15. 23</ls>. यथार्हदण्डो (राजा) पूज्यः <ls>Kau. A. 1. 4</ls>; सुविज्ञातप्रणीतो हि दण्डः प्रजां धर्मार्थकामैर्योजयति <ls>Kau. A. 1. 4</ls> .²16 Imprisonment. .²17 Attack, assault, violence, punishment, the last of the four expedients; see उपाय; सामादीनामुपायानां चतुर्णामपि पण्डिताः . सामदण्डौ प्रशंसन्ति नित्यं राष्ट्राभिवृद्धये .. <ls>Ms. 7. 109</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Śi. 2. 54</ls>. .²18 An army; तस्य दण्डवतो दण्डः स्वदेहान्न व्यशिष्यत <ls>R. 17. 62</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 65</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 294</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 15</ls>. .²19 A form of military array; <ls>Mb. 12. 59. 40</ls>. .²20 Subjection, control, restraint; वाग्दण्डोऽथ मनोदण्डः कायदण्डस्तथैव च . यस्यैते निहिता बुद्धौ त्रिदण्डीति स उच्यते .. <ls>Ms. 12. 10</ls>. .²21 A measure of length equal to 4 Hastas; <ls>Bṛ. S. 24. 9</ls>. .²22 The penis. .²23 Pride; या चापि न्यस्तदण्डानां तां गतिं व्रज पुत्रक <ls>Mb. 7. 78. 25</ls>. .²24 The body. .²25 An epithet of Yama. .²26 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²27 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²28 An attendant on the sun. .²29 A horse (said to be {%m.%} only in this and the preceding four senses). .²30 A particular appearance in the sky (similar to a stick). .²31 An uninterrupted row or series, a line. .²32 Standing upright or erect. .²33 A corner, an angle. .²34 The Science of <ab>Govt.</ab> विनयमूलो दण्डः, दण्डमूलास्तिस्रो विद्याः <ls>Kau. A. 1. 5</ls>. .²35 Harm, injury; न्यासो दण्डस्य भूतेषु मनोवाक्कायजस्य यः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 8</ls>.
